segments.title: Pepito Broadcast Sign-On
segments.notes: Pepito delivers the official top-of-hour sign-on and countdown while running around the office.

segments.title: Opening Banter: Kendall's Ears and Hype Train Sub Thanking
segments.notes: Case and Kendall discuss Orlando trip and Disney ears; Case performs Hype Train-style rap to thank subscribers after the train ends early.

segments.title: Don Rickles Studio Interruption
segments.notes: Don Rickles appears on set trading insults with Case about hygiene and employment status.

segments.title: Oscars Recap with Liliana
segments.notes: Liliana joins desk to review 2025 Oscar winners including Anora sweep, Conan O'Brien's $15k hosting fee, and No Other Land acceptance speech on Palestinian displacement.

segments.title: Conspiracy Time: Casino Industry Secrets with Clementine
segments.notes: Clementine Vernon returns from hiding to deliver a casino conspiracy monologue criticizing algorithmic risk-rating and intense background music.

segments.title: Amongst the Web: Viral Video Review with Clementine
segments.notes: Clementine watches and rates viewer-submitted clips including a coaster POV, casino security cam, hit-clips robot, hide-and-seek, raccoon ad, brick-layer revenge, and big man blast.

segments.title: Streamer News: Hassan Piker Ban and Rick Scott Controversy
segments.notes: Case covers Hassan Piker's fifth Twitch ban for saying 'kill Rick Scott' during Medicare fraud discussion; debates incitement vs. political rhetoric.

segments.title: IRL Streamer Harassment Incident
segments.notes: Case and Liliana discuss creep stalking and death threats against Emiru, Cinna, and Valkyrae during Santa Monica Pier IRL stream.

segments.title: Munch & Crum: Best Date Ideas Debate
segments.notes: Munch and Crum debate 'best date ideas' (vibes vs. snakes) while Crum's gorilla creditor looms; Crum's debt cited at $165k–$180k.

segments.title: How To with Jeb: Turkey Meatloaf and Hoagie Trailer
segments.notes: Jeb and his deceased father (trapped in a wooden board) demonstrate turkey meatloaf, watch a Hoagie movie trailer, and view a 1990s anti-drug PSA.

segments.title: News Roundup with Peter Gibbon
segments.notes: Peter Gibbon rapid-fires headlines: Trump pauses Ukraine aid, fart walks, bat guano cannabis deaths, Oscar memorial snubs, Danish piglet starvation art exhibit, and gorilla flatulence study.

segments.title: Jambalaya: Who Secretly Loves Rick Scott?
segments.notes: Panel game with Chet, Liliana, Jake Whitehole, and Stankmonius guessing which panelist loves Rick Scott; ends with jet ski butt-rock fantasy.

segments.title: Sign-Off and Raid to Psycorp
segments.notes: Case wraps broadcast, announces Patreon and schedule, raids Psycorp.

lore_notes.fact: Pepito's Snap Camera filter broken by Patrick Trumpis server update; engineers working on fix, Amtaro Stream on hold until resolved.
Jeb Nogget missing for ~2 weeks after mumbling 'the well was calling to him' and hanging up on Case.
Hassan Piker received fifth Twitch ban for stating 'if you cared about Medicare fraud you would kill Rick Scott' during political commentary.
IRL stalker threatened to kill Emiru, Cinna, and Valkyrae on Santa Monica Pier stream; victims had no security.
Crum's gorilla creditor appeared in his living room playing piano; debt accrues interest weekly if not paid down.
Danish artist starving three piglets in shopping-cart cage exhibit (opened Friday) to protest factory farming; goldfish-blender precedent noted.
BBC Spy in the Wild captured mountain gorillas in 'semi-permanent state of flatulence' from 20kg daily consumption.

episode_summary: Barely Informed News covered the Oscars with Liliana, then pivoted to streamer controversies: Hassan Piker's ban for a 'kill Rick Scott' remark and a stalker threatening female IRL streamers. Crum debated Munch on date ideas while his pneumatic gorilla creditor loomed, Jeb and his board-trapped father made meatloaf, Peter Gibbon rapid-fired a news roundup including a Danish piglet-starvation art exhibit, and a Jambalaya panel failed to identify the secret Rick Scott admirer before Case raided Psycorp.
